gloss: problem area; issue; point at issue

definitions.gloss: problem area; issue; point at issue; problematic aspect
definitions.explanation: A specific aspect or element of something that is problematic or needs to be addressed. Often used in discussions, reports, and analyses to identify what needs fixing.

examples.japanese: {問題点|もんだいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指摘|してき}する→指摘する：27890_shitekisuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{問題点|もんだいてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are several issues with this plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{問題点|もんだいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}い{出|だ}して→洗い出す：27520_araidasu⟧⟦{改善案|かいぜんあん}→改善案：27964_kaizenan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: The committee identified the problems with the system and compiled an improvement plan.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (problem) + ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point, aspect). More specific than ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ alone — it refers to particular aspects or elements that are problematic, rather than a problem in general.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {問題点|もんだいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指摘|してき}する→指摘する：27890_shitekisuru⟧ (to point out problems)
- {問題点|もんだいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}い{出|だ}す→洗い出す：27520_araidasu⟧ (to identify/uncover problems)
- {問題点|もんだいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧ (to organize/sort out the issues)
- {問題点|もんだいてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる→浮かび上がる：06858_ukabiagaru⟧ (for problems to emerge)
- {問題点|もんだいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}する→克服する：15863_kokufukusuru⟧ (to overcome the issues)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ — problem; broader and more general
- ⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧ — task, challenge; implies something that needs to be worked on
- ⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧ — flaw, defect; refers to inherent shortcomings

USAGE:
{問題点|もんだいてん} is standard in business, academic, and policy discussions. It is analytical in tone, used when breaking down a situation into its specific problematic elements rather than referring to a problem as a whole.
